newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas continues higher with 3 deals in October.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas continues higher with 3 deals in October.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract continued to show healthy activity on Tuesday morning with 75 lots traded in October at higher prices.
The three deals, done at up to 10.875 pence a therm or 0.095 pence above the previous settlement level, followed 450 lots traded on Monday.
"Someone's obviously making the market. The ranges are an awful lot narrower than previously," said a futures broker.

He pointed out that there was a lot of interest in October. A number of players are waiting for October to become the spot month as at that point October 1998, the month in which the Interconnector pipeline to Zeebrugge opens, will be traded on the screen. This is expected by some players to create extra interest in trading futures.
October 1997 already has the highest volume of open interest of any contract month.
By the midday close of the session, front month August was bid at 9.40 pence and offered at 9.595 pence.
